{{Quote|The fleet won't be modern, but it will be deadly.|[[Natasi Daala]]|<ref name="R">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
The '''Maw Irregular Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
It was named after the [[Maw Installation]], where Daala had been residing on behalf of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]].<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>
Daala amassed the fleet while in years of seclusion behind [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] after her escape in the [[Scylla (frigate)|''Scylla'']] following the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The fleet was mainly composed of outdated ships, but equipped with unorthodox deadly weapons including [[Metal-Crystal Phase Shifter]]s. It fought at the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] in [[41 ABY]], where it turned the tide of the battle against [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] favor. After the battle, the fleet gained the Star Destroyer [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the late [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. Daala and the Maw Irregular Fleet joined the [[Jedi Coalition]] soon after.<ref name="R" /> The fleet was present at the [[Second Battle of Roche]] later that year.<ref name="I">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

After the end of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Natasi Daala]] became the [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] the fleet was hidden from public view until it was needed but due to the expensive cost of the Metal-Crystal Phase Shifters they were removed from all vessels. In [[44 ABY]], the time came for the fleet to be in use again when Daala was arrested after a successful coup creating the first Triumvirate of the Galactic Alliance. After freed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], Daala reactivated the fleet and brought it to the [[Exodo system/Legends|Exodo system]], where it rendezvoused with a supplement of [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] starships from Moffs that she had blackmailed or thought that she should take control of the Remnant out from [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], but due to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles]] secret loyalty to Fel, the fleet along with the Remnant supplement where ambushed in the system. Jagged Fel massed a fleet composing of several loyal Imperial Remnant ships as well as the Vanguard of the [[Empire of the Hand]], believed by the greater galaxy to have been disbanded or destroyed in the aftermath of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The [[Battle over Exodo II]] ensued with both sides taking heavy ship losses, but the usurpers were able to destroy the [[Gilad Pellaeon (starship)|''Gilad Pellaeon'']], trying to kill Jagged Fel as the vessel served as his command ship. It failed as the Imperial Head of State was able to be transferred over to the [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']], once more holding the Head of State of the Imperial Remnant safely aboard.

==Composition==
{{Quote|You know what we girls are like. We just can't throw anything away in case it comes back into fashion years later.|Natasi Daala, to [[Darth Caedus]]|<ref name="R" />}}
The fleet's complement was:
*[[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] {{C|Flagship}}
*1 [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]
*1 [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]
*1 [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]
*2 [[Republic-class cruiser|''Republic''-class cruisers]]
*[[Scimitar-class frigate|''Scimitar''-class frigates]]
*2 [[Crusader-class corvette|''Crusader''-class corvettes]]
*[[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvettes]]
*[[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]
*Various [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] models from multiple eras
